title: Factoring two terms from a product
statement: Let $P$ be a finite set, let $a,b\in P$ be distinct, and let $F:P\to\mathbb R$. Then $\prod_{p\in P}F(p)=F(a)F(b)\prod_{p\in P\setminus\{a,b\}}F(p)$.
